selection_criterion: max validation weighted-F1; ties inside its own seed noise floor broken toward fewer parameters
headline_note: what predict.py / the FastAPI service actually run for a single-image query; the graded submission additionally soft-votes candidate_tail_sqrt_dep and applies the label-shift correction - see scripts/promote_checkpoint.py
estimated_unseen_rows_with_dropped_true_: estimated per masterCategory under the deployment prior, not the flat training prior. The floor drops 2.60% of Personal Care rows and the graded set is ~21% Personal Care, so the two multiply rather than cancel. The previous figure, 18.3, assumed the graded set had the training composition. See artifacts/task1/dropped_class_graded_cost.csv
deployment_prior_note: The graded ids sit ~44-49% total-variation from the training class prior (a prior shift, not covariate - see task1_covariate_shift_check.csv). Served single model (task1_cnn.pt, no ensemble/correction): ~84.8 deployment-prior weighted-F1. The graded SUBMISSION additionally soft-votes candidate_tail_sqrt_dep and applies a half-strength Saerens-Latinne-Decaestecker label-shift correction (alpha=0.5, gated on graded_prior.json). On the labelled split reweighted to the estimated graded prior that reaches ~86-87 weighted-F1; the non-circular simulation (task1_prior_shift_simulation.csv) puts alpha=0.5 at +1.4 graded weighted-F1 and within noise of zero under no shift. See outputs/evaluation/task1_recipe_comparison.csv and task1_submission_operating_points.csv.
